summary: YYForce Inc., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under YFOR, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $20,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares through sales agent Spartan Capital Securities, LLC. Sales occur from time to time at market prices; Spartan receives 3.75% of gross proceeds and acts as underwriter. Shares closed at $1.46 on October 2, 2026. Outstanding: 7,836,734 Class A and 5,000,000 Class B shares, the latter carrying 500 votes each. No escrow, price, or closing date is stated. Routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution and controlled-company overhang.
